required_new_entry_gates: standard sequence, no new sequon, no unrecorded framework edit
complete local novelty searches and CDRH3 safeguard
strict both-species minimized geometry and full receptor/glycan context
positive direction across independent human histidine assumptions
front_of_panel_promotion: Only prespecified M00018/M00021 if both full no-extra-chirality-restraint thermal comparisons meet all predeclared descriptive guardrails, expanded protonation is acid-on across all assumptions, loss versus matched parent is at most0.10kcal/mol, and all geometry/novelty safeguards pass. Rank such candidates by conservative expanded contrast, treating tiny energy differences as non-calibrated experimental priorities.
otherwise: Do not call a variant stabilized or replace the original leader on that basis. Passing new variants can replace lowest-evidence tail reserves; failed stress tests stay explicit.
rest_of_panel: Retain original top20 ordering except insertion of any strictly qualified promoted variants. Other qualified new entries follow original top20, ordered by expanded-evidence availability, human histidine contrast within narrower-evidence entries, and deterministic ID tie-break. Trim from original tail to keep exactly100.
diversity: Reject repeated amino-acid sequences. Limit any CDRH3 to at most6 entries as in original release; report unique CDRH3 counts rather than claiming new binding-mode diversity.
name_policy: Keep public names stable for retained old sequences; assign unrelated biochemical-pun names to new ones. File order, not the numerical text within older names, determines the revised rank.
no_claims: All experimental affinity, pH specificity, mouse reactivity, expression/folding and official novelty/classification remain unverified.
